* * * *
 The Police Sub-Inspector of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 and 2 for the offences punishable U/s.498A of IPC. & Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Ayesha Sultana.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 got married with CW-1 on 21-11-2020.
At the time of marriage, accused have demanded and taken dowry from the complainant and her family.

After the marriage, the accused No.1 and 2 have subjected CW-1 to cruelty both physically and mentally in respect of dowry by demanding her to get money, gold ornaments and home appliances from her parents.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.43/2023 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing them and the Smt Ayeshs Sulthana vs Abdul Naushad on 3 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92645879/

sentences.text: and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.

5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have  committed the offences punishable U/s.498A of IPC. &
Sec.4 of D.P. Act.?
 2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.

3 jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

sentences.text: In order to bring home the guilt of the accused

,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt. Ayesha Sultana.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with  5  C.C.No.16625/2023 accused No.1 was performed on 21-11-2020 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never threatened to kill her. PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.

Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon Smt Ayeshs Sulthana vs Abdul Naushad on 3 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92645879/
4 other chargesheeted witnesses.

sentences.text: Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the  6  C.C.No.16625/2023 material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER In exercise of power conferred Under are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.498A of IPC. &
Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
